scope: FloorFlow residential predicted-control reconstruction and the separately labeled Raster2Seq-proposal hybrid

fpvec_lab.usage: direct dependency for validity, watertightness, wall/opening matching, room matching, and topology-aware edit cost

raster2seq.usage: official result_jsons for official_* values; local row adapter only for explicitly labeled adapter_* diagnostics

gsdiff.usage: protocol reference for typed room nodes, shared-edge adjacency, and NetworkX graph edit distance

housemind.usage: published Node F1, edge-overlap, GED, Delta-IoU, and Delta-MSE protocol context only; no direct reproduction claim

dplan.usage: 2026 graph/minimal-connectivity design reference only; rectangular-plot prototype is not a CubiCasa executable baseline

floorplan_vlm.usage: 2026 polygon-sequence representation reference only; no verified matched executable is available in this workspace

reno_layout.usage: 2026 editing-context reference only; no matched benchmark execution is enabled

official_room_iou.definition: Raster2Seq room precision and recall use each predicted-to-ground-truth IoU above 0.5 while ignoring the wall-mask region; reported F1 is the harmonic mean of the case-level precision and recall.

official_room_semantic_f1.definition: Raster2Seq semantic room F1 requires the same room-IoU match and exact room-type agreement.

official_corner_f1.definition: For each matched room, a predicted corner matches a target corner within 10 pixels; precision and recall are computed over predicted and target corner counts, then combined into F1.

official_angle_f1.definition: A corner-angle prediction is correct when its matched polygon corner is within 10 pixels and its angle differs by at most 5 degrees.

official_opening_f1.definition: A door/window endpoint pair matches when the type agrees and each endpoint is within 10 pixels under the better endpoint orientation; precision and recall use predicted and target opening counts.

adapter_room_macro_iou.definition: Macro IoU over room classes after rendering the FloorFlow explicit-room plan; reported only as an adapter diagnostic.
adapter_room_macro_iou.role: adapter diagnostic; never substituted for official_room_iou

adapter_instance_f1.definition: One-to-one Hungarian room-instance matching at IoU 0.5, with independent instance precision, recall, and F1.

node_f1.definition: Precision, recall, and F1 over unique room types in the HouseMind-style graph view.
node_f1.role: structure metric aligned to HouseMind's public protocol family

edge_f1.definition: Precision, recall, and F1 over shared-boundary room-type pairs; canonical one-to-one instance edges are reported separately.

ged.definition: NetworkX graph edit distance on unique room-type nodes with unit node insertion/deletion/substitution and shared-edge adjacency; the timeout and exact-indicator policy are fixed per report.

validity.definition: Conjunction of outer-boundary closure, room-polygon closure, no self-intersection, no room overlap, and complete legal room semantics.

raw_watertightness.definition: The unchanged fpeval room-partition watertightness result; multi-component footprints are not silently converted to success.

componentwise_watertightness.definition: Functional diagnostic requiring validity, zero overlap, exact room-union coverage, component-count agreement with exportable footprint components, and sufficient room-face retention.
componentwise_watertightness.role: functional diagnostic reported beside raw watertightness

wall_continuity.definition: Fraction of wall-junction clusters incident to at least two wall segments after the frozen junction-clustering tolerance.

plan_plausibility.definition: Conjunction of parseability, five-check validity, room closure, no self-intersection, no overlap, no out-of-boundary geometry, wall continuity, room-face retention, and functional watertightness.

hard_fail_policy: A missing source implementation makes a metric diagnostic-only.
A target-derived input invalidates a deployable row.
A structural threshold cannot be changed after observing a full evaluation.
A multi-component footprint cannot be treated as a single-region watertight sample without labeling the protocol boundary.
A hybrid cannot be renamed as standalone FloorFlow.
